verdict.rationale: Docs show flexible card issuance (virtual/physical, Visa/Mastercard) and balance-account models (pooled or per-card funding), which implies some prepaid/debit-style flexibility, but there is no explicit mention of credit-line issuance, commercial card programs, or distinct consumer vs. commercial credit product support. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of debit, prepaid, commercial credit, and consumer credit program types with credit-line/repayment mechanics.
